fact: UNDP reports the IEC registers voters through Mobile Registration Devices and an outsourced Voter Registration Management System, with 1,388,207 voters on the roll as of September 2023.

The Independent Electoral Commission issued an open tender in May 2024 for an Electoral Management Information System to register electors, and awarded the contract to Waymark Infotech, which Laxton contests in the High Court; the IEC says the current register dates from 2001.
The IEC said its re-registration campaign uses National Identification Cards as the sole form of identification for voters, including those previously registered on other documents.

The Commonwealth Observer Group was informed that a new electronic system of registering voters, the Mobile Registration Unit, instituted in June 2022, captures the elector's biometric data and personal details.
The Commonwealth Observer Group states the new electronic voter registration system is linked to the elector's national ID card and requires an ID card to register.

The IEC said its nationwide re-registration campaign registers voters at its offices and through an online portal on its website, with at least 18,570 registered by mid-October 2024, about 3,000 of them online.
Lesotho's IEC has hired a private auditor to examine the voters' roll, the servers holding voters' data and the registration systems, the commission said.

fact: Lesotho's IEC says it began a national voter re-registration on 1 August 2024, with about 65,000 people in its database by late November 2024 and online registration offered.

The IEC told the AU follow-up mission it had a modernised voter registration system with online registration services and a fresh nationwide registration exercise in 2024, with over 579,520 citizens registered.
The IEC said its voter registration system is integrated with the National Identity and Civil Registry (NICR) through Unique Identification Numbers.
